title: MMT of the Shoulder Girdle and Arm — Catching the Cheats

hook.en: A weak muscle always borrows help from a stronger neighbour. Learn to spot the shrug, the lean and the swing so a "4/5" really means a 4/5 in the muscle you meant to test.
hook.ur: Kamzor muscle hamesha mazboot padosi se madad leta hai. Shrug, lean aur swing pehchanna seekhein taake “4/5” ka matlab wohi muscle ho jisay aap test karna chahte the.

goal.en: By the end, you'll test the serratus anterior, trapezius, rhomboids, deltoid and elbow flexors and extensors correctly and name the substitution for each.
goal.ur: End tak aap serratus anterior, trapezius, rhomboids, deltoid aur elbow flexors aur extensors sahi test karenge aur har ek ki substitution batayenge.

text.en: Every movement can be done by **more than one muscle**. When the prime mover is weak the patient recruits synergists: the upper trapezius to lift the arm, the trunk to lean, the wrist flexors to bend the fingers. A good MMT watches the **whole body**, not just the limb, and uses the **standard position** that makes the cheat difficult. The three questions: What is the prime mover? What will help it? How do I stop the help?
text.ur: Har movement **ek se zyada muscles** kar sakte hain. Prime mover kamzor ho to patient synergists ko bulata hai: arm uthane ke liye upper trapezius, jhukne ke liye trunk, fingers mor'ne ke liye wrist flexors. Acha MMT sirf limb nahi, **poora jism** dekhta hai aur **standard position** use karta hai jo cheating mushkil kar de. Teen sawal: Prime mover kaun hai? Isay kaun madad dega? Madad ko kaise roka jaye?

text.en: A weak muscle is a weak team member in a group project: someone stronger quietly does their share. You find out by watching who actually moves, not by looking only at the final result.
text.ur: Kamzor muscle group project ka kamzor member hai: koi mazboot khamoshi se uska hissa kar deta hai. Aap yeh is se jaante hain ke dekhte hain asal mein kaun hil raha hai, sirf aakhri nateeja nahi.

beats.title: Serratus anterior — pushing the scapula round the ribs

intro.en: The arm is flexed to about 90–120° and the examiner resists upward elevation of the arm. Watch the scapula: a weak serratus anterior lets the **medial border wing** off the ribs. Substitutions include pectoralis major and the upper trapezius shrugging.
intro.ur: Arm takriban 90–120° flex hota hai aur examiner arm ki upar ki taraf elevation ko resist karta hai. Scapula dekhein: kamzor serratus anterior mein **medial border** ribs se **wing** karta hai. Substitutions mein pectoralis major aur shrugging upper trapezius shamil hain.

question.en: During shoulder abduction testing, a patient's shoulder rises toward the ear as the arm lifts. What is happening?
question.ur: Shoulder abduction test karte waqt patient ka shoulder arm uthate hue kaan ki taraf uthta hai. Kya ho raha hai?

text.en: The upper trapezius is substituting for a weak deltoid or supraspinatus
text.ur: Kamzor deltoid ya supraspinatus ki jagah upper trapezius substitute kar raha hai

feedback.en: Yes — a shrug during shoulder flexion or abduction is the classic upper trapezius cheat. Ask the patient to relax the shoulder and stabilise the scapula.
feedback.ur: Haan — shoulder flexion ya abduction ke dauran shrug classic upper trapezius cheating hai. Patient se shoulder dheela karne ko kahein aur scapula ko stabilise karein.

feedback.en: A strong deltoid lifts the arm without a shrug.
feedback.ur: Mazboot deltoid shrug ke bagair arm uthata hai.

text.ur: Patient sirf stretch kar raha hai

feedback.en: A shrug is a compensation, not a stretch.

intro.en: Prone with the arm abducted to 90° and externally rotated, the patient lifts the arm toward the ceiling while the examiner resists at the distal humerus and stabilises the trunk. The rhomboids, posterior deltoid and the opposite side tilting the trunk can substitute.
intro.ur: Prone, arm 90° abducted aur externally rotated, patient arm ko chhat ki taraf uthata hai aur examiner distal humerus par resist karta hai aur trunk ko stabilise karta hai. Rhomboids, posterior deltoid aur trunk ko tilt karne wali opposite side substitute kar sakte hain.

intro.en: Prone or supine with the shoulder abducted: the patient straightens the elbow while the examiner resists at the distal forearm. Watch for the shoulder swinging forward and the wrist flexors "locking" the elbow (substitution), and for gravity helping when the forearm hangs.
intro.ur: Prone ya supine, shoulder abducted: patient elbow seedha karta hai aur examiner distal forearm par resist karta hai. Shoulder ke aage swing hone par aur wrist flexors ke elbow ko “lock” karne (substitution) par, aur forearm latkne par gravity ki madad par nazar rakhein.

rows.en: Relax the shoulder, stabilise the scapula and the trunk
rows.ur: Shoulder dheela karein, scapula aur trunk stabilise karein

rows.en: Wrist flexors bending first, shoulder swinging forward
rows.ur: Pehle wrist flexors ka mor'na, shoulder ka aage swing

rows.en: Forearm supinated for the biceps, keep the wrist relaxed, stabilise the upper arm
rows.ur: Biceps ke liye forearm supinated, wrist dheela, upper arm stabilise

rows.en: Finger extensors extending first (the wrist follows)
rows.ur: Pehle finger extensors ka extend hona (wrist follow karti hai)

rows.en: Keep the fingers relaxed and test the wrist first
rows.ur: Fingers dheeli rakhein aur pehle wrist test karein

rows.en: Tenodesis: wrist extension passively closes the fingers; wrist flexion opens them
rows.ur: Tenodesis: wrist extension fingers ko passively band karti hai; wrist flexion kholti hai

rows.en: Keep the wrist in neutral and support the forearm
rows.ur: Wrist ko neutral rakhein aur forearm ko support dein

text.en: **Not watching the scapula.** For shoulder tests, the scapula tells the truth: winging means serratus anterior; a shrug means upper trapezius; the lower angle moving sideways means the lower trapezius or serratus. Many "weak shoulder" patients have a **scapular** problem and a normal rotator cuff. Always look from behind, bare the shoulder blade and test the scapular muscles before blaming the cuff.
text.ur: **Scapula ko na dekhna.** Shoulder tests mein scapula sach batati hai: winging matlab serratus anterior; shrug matlab upper trapezius; lower angle ka side mein hilna matlab lower trapezius ya serratus. Bohat se “kamzor shoulder” wale patients ko **scapular** masla hota hai aur rotator cuff normal. Peechay se dekhein, shoulder blade ko nanga karein aur cuff ko zimmedar thehrane se pehle scapular muscles test karein.

question.en: In the prone middle trapezius test, the patient rotates the trunk to lift the arm higher. What should you do?
question.ur: Prone middle trapezius test mein patient arm ko zyada uthane ke liye trunk ghumata hai. Kya karna chahiye?

text.en: Stabilise the trunk and ask the patient to lift only the arm; note the grade you can get without the trunk
text.ur: Trunk ko stabilise karein aur patient se sirf arm uthwayein; trunk ke bagair jo grade milay woh note karein

feedback.en: Yes — the grade is only valid for the arm movement without trunk rotation.
feedback.ur: Haan — grade sirf trunk rotation ke bagair arm ki movement ke liye valid hai.

text.en: Accept the larger range and record 5/5
text.ur: Bari range maan kar 5/5 likh dein

feedback.en: The range includes substitution, so the result is false.
feedback.ur: Range mein substitution shamil hai, is liye result ghalat hai.

text.en: Stop the test and skip the muscle
text.ur: Test rok kar muscle chhor dein

feedback.ur: Stabilisation masle ko hal kar deti hai.

text.en: **From grades to treatment.** A weak middle or lower trapezius with an overactive upper trapezius is a classic shoulder pain pattern; the answer is not "strengthen everything" but to **teach scapular setting first**, then load the weak muscle in a position where the strong one cannot cheat (prone Y, T and W exercises, wall slides). Retest in the same position so a 3 becomes a 4 on the same muscle, not on a helper.
text.ur: **Grades se ilaaj tak.** Kamzor middle ya lower trapezius aur zyada active upper trapezius shoulder ke dard ka classic pattern hai; hal “sab kuch strengthen karein” nahi, balkey **pehle scapular setting sikhayein**, phir kamzor muscle ko aisi position mein load karein jahan mazboot cheat na kar sake (prone Y, T aur W exercises, wall slides). Usi position mein dobara test karein taake ek 3 usi muscle par 4 bane, kisi madadgar par nahi.

question.en: Why does the Biodex or hand-held dynamometer often show a deficit that the manual grade of "5/5" missed?
question.ur: Biodex ya hand-held dynamometer aksar aisi kami dikhata hai jo manual “5/5” grade se chhoot gayi?

answer.en: Because manual testing cannot detect a loss until the muscle is clearly weaker than the examiner (for large muscles roughly less than half of normal), whereas a dynamometer measures force in kilograms. A sportsperson with 80% of the strength of the other side can still be graded 5/5.
answer.ur: Kyunke manual testing us waqt tak kami nahi pakar sakti jab tak muscle examiner se saaf kamzor na ho (bare muscles mein takriban normal ke aadhe se kam), jabke dynamometer force kilograms mein naapta hai. Doosri side ki 80 % taqat wala sportsperson phir bhi 5/5 grade ho sakta hai.

question.en: A patient flexes the elbow but their wrist flexes first and the shoulder swings forward. What substitution is this?
question.ur: Patient elbow flex karta hai lekin pehle uski wrist flex hoti hai aur shoulder aage swing karta hai. Yeh kaun si substitution hai?

text.en: Wrist flexors and shoulder flexors substituting for a weak biceps/brachialis
text.ur: Kamzor biceps/brachialis ki jagah wrist flexors aur shoulder flexors substitute kar rahe hain

feedback.en: Yes — support the upper arm, keep the wrist neutral and retest.
feedback.ur: Haan — upper arm ko support dein, wrist neutral rakhein aur dobara test karein.

feedback.en: Normal flexion is smooth, with the shoulder still and the wrist relaxed.
feedback.ur: Normal flexion smooth hoti hai, shoulder saakin aur wrist dheeli.

feedback.en: A nerve palsy would not show active compensating movements this way.
feedback.ur: Nerve palsy mein aise active compensating movements nahi hote.

text.en: **Stop and refer** if resisted testing reproduces severe pain or a clunk after a fall or lifting injury (possible tear or fracture), if the weakness is sudden with neck pain or neurological signs (nerve, cord or stroke), or if the arm is cold, pale and pulseless. Do not resist an arm that is in a sling or protocol-restricted after surgery.
text.ur: **Ruk jayein aur refer karein** agar resisted testing se girne ya uthane ki chot ke baad shadeed dard ya clunk reproduce ho (shayad tear ya fracture), kamzori achanak ho gardan ke dard ya neurological signs ke saath (nerve, cord ya stroke), ya arm thanda, peela aur bina pulse ho. Sling mein ya surgery ke baad protocol se mahdood arm ko resist na karein.

summary.en: Every movement has helpers; watch the whole body and use the standard position that blocks the cheat.
summary.ur: Har movement ke madadgar hotay hain; poora jism dekhein aur woh standard position use karein jo cheating roke.

summary.en: Classic cheats: shrug for shoulder lift, trunk lean, wrist flexors for elbow flexion, tenodesis in the hand, winging for serratus anterior.
summary.ur: Classic cheats: shoulder uthane ke liye shrug, trunk lean, elbow flexion ke liye wrist flexors, haath mein tenodesis, serratus anterior ke liye winging.

summary.en: Watch the scapula, retest in the same position and use a dynamometer for strong muscles; refer for sudden weakness, severe pain or vascular signs.
summary.ur: Scapula dekhein, usi position mein dobara test karein aur mazboot muscles ke liye dynamometer use karein; achanak kamzori, shadeed dard ya vascular signs par refer karein.

front.en: What does scapular winging with wall push-up suggest?
front.ur: Wall push-up par scapular winging kya batati hai?

back.en: Weak serratus anterior (long thoracic nerve); the medial border lifts off the ribs.
back.ur: Kamzor serratus anterior (long thoracic nerve); medial border ribs se uth jata hai.

front.en: Which muscle substitutes by shrugging in shoulder abduction?
front.ur: Shoulder abduction mein shrug kar ke kaun sa muscle substitute karta hai?

back.en: Passive finger closure on wrist extension (and opening on wrist flexion) from tendon tension; it can fake finger flexion.
back.ur: Wrist extension par fingers ka passively band hona (aur wrist flexion par khulna) tendon tension se; yeh finger flexion ki naqal kar sakta hai.

front.en: Why is a 5/5 not always normal?

back.en: Manual testing cannot break a strong muscle, so a 20–50% deficit can hide at grade 5; use a dynamometer.
back.ur: Manual testing mazboot muscle ko tor nahi sakti, is liye 20–50 % kami grade 5 mein chhup sakti hai; dynamometer use karein.

note.en: Test serratus anterior, trapezius and more in 3D.
note.ur: Serratus anterior, trapezius aur mazeed 3D mein test karein.

note.en: The scapula's partnership with the humerus.
note.ur: Scapula ki humerus ke saath shirakat.
